input.prompt: Wide painted night sky above a quiet city, for the background of a miniature rooftop diorama. Soft atmospheric haze near the horizon. Painterly, tactile, calm and elegant illustration style matching a stylized miniature diorama; no people, no text, no logos, no planes, no foreground objects, no rooftop terrace in the foreground.
